Transform your employee experienceKey Services

Transform your employee experience

Exterprise's ServiceNow experts deliver seamless implementations, process integrations, and extensions of your ServiceNow platform to provide a unified ITSM solution across the enterprise. Predictive Intelligence classifies and routes incoming incidents by category, priority, and assignment group automatically, while Now Assist summarizes cases and drafts resolution notes directly inside Agent Workspace.

Our business and technical consultants bring deep, cross-industry ServiceNow implementation experience, and Exterprise holds direct Now Assist for ITSM (Pro Plus Suite) certification — so Virtual Agent self-service and Now Assist case summarization get configured around your actual categories and resolution patterns, not generic defaults.
